caveat: Framework paper with no empirical test. Uhl-Bien's complexity leadership is about organisational adaptation, not Juarrero's enabling constraints, so the two should not be run together.
source: Consensus; Journal watch: Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence
title: Leveraging complex systems: Leading for transformative change
why: Turns Complexity Leadership Theory into a management framework (SPARK) for institutions absorbing generative AI: the administrative mirror image of your AI and Professional Criticality argument, and a clear case of complexity used as a steering vocabulary.
